$comment: GAIA verify lanes — local mirror of CI quality gates (.github/workflows/ci.yml). name matches the CI job/step (rows may be step-granular). ci_check = the ci.yml check (one step of a grouped job, posted as the `ci / <area> / <check>` commit status) that runs this lane on a PR push; `verdict.py reuse-plan` reuses a check's last pass on the PR while nx would not select its task for what changed since, so a lane without ci_check (or without nx) always runs. Only fast-tier checks carry one: reuse applies to pull_request runs only, and the audits and the live PostHog check are never reused. nx = the Nx task whose inputs decide whether this lane runs, in CI, in `verdict.py reuse-plan` and in `mise ci:local` alike (.github/jobs/<job>/project.json, or a real project for gaia-connect and alert-rules). A lane with no nx task has scope instead: a Python regex over changed paths; it runs if ANY file matches (--all overrides). heavy=true needs --with-heavy. timeout_s hard cap; expiry -> status=timeout (exit 2). require_cmd: any missing -> skipped(missing-tool). require_env: an unset credential skips the lane in automatic selection (reason printed), while --only <lane> still runs it so it fails loud. command runs at repo root; a lane whose nx task is runnable has none, and ci:local runs `nx run <task>`, the line CI's step runs (test_workflow_nx_gates.py holds the two equal). Edit a workflow lane and this file in the SAME commit. INTENTIONALLY NOT MIRRORED (CI-only): build, build-images, coverage (combines the unit/integration/bridge slices; fail-under 80 on master, report-only on PRs), docker-image, regression-proof, validate-release-manifest, test-harness-tools, test-python (the full pytest suite is CI's job; locally run files with `mise test:one`), trivy-scan (advisory), changelog-sync (auto-fix PR job). Known deltas: alert-rules needs locally installed pint/promtool (CI pins v0.87.0/v3.1.0 from release tarballs); whole-repo scopes are stricter than CI's changed-file scoping (safe direction). Post-merge note: master pinned bandit/xenon/interrogate and split ignore-ratchet into ignore-whys + ignore-staleness + tool-pins (2026-08 merge of origin/master).

lanes.name: deps
lanes.command: pnpm run quality:deps && pnpm run quality:pkg-json

lanes.name: api-schema
lanes.$comment: The generated API contract's lane. What can change it is lint-mixed:api-schema's nx inputs (.github/jobs/lint-mixed/project.json): a FastAPI/Pydantic bump changes the output with no route edit, so the manifests count. The prek `api-types` hook's `files:` regex copies them; scripts/ci/tests/test_hook_scopes.py holds the two equal.

lanes.name: package-hygiene
lanes.command: pnpm run quality:publint && pnpm run quality:attw

lanes.name: go-connect
lanes.command: cd tools/gaia-connect && go vet ./... && go test ./... && cd ../.. && bash scripts/ci/release.sh connect-cross-check

lanes.name: python-mypy
lanes.command: uv run --project apps/api --frozen --group backend --group dev mypy apps/api/app libs/shared/py tools/lints --ignore-missing-imports && python3 scripts/ci/runner.py heal-venv .venv-voice-agent && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv-voice-agent uv run --project apps/voice-agent --frozen --group dev mypy apps/voice-agent/src --ignore-missing-imports --cache-dir .mypy_cache/voice-agent && MYPYPATH=scripts/ci:scripts/ci/tests uv run --project apps/api --frozen --group backend --group dev mypy --explicit-package-bases scripts/ci --ignore-missing-imports --cache-dir .mypy_cache/scripts-ci

lanes.name: import-cost
lanes.$comment: Imports the real modules in fresh subprocesses, so it needs the synced venv; --report matches the CI step, which measures without gating until the base layers stop importing upward.

lanes.name: alert-rules
lanes.command: uv run --no-build tools/alert-rules/extract_promql.py -o tools/alert-rules/gaia-rules.yaml --test-dir tools/alert-rules/tests && pint --no-color --offline --config config/pint.hcl lint tools/alert-rules/gaia-rules.yaml && promtool check rules tools/alert-rules/gaia-rules.yaml && promtool test rules tools/alert-rules/tests/*.yaml

lanes.name: semgrep
lanes.command: GITDIR=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir) && docker run --rm --volume "$PWD:/src" --volume "$GITDIR:$GITDIR" --workdir /src semgrep/semgrep@sha256:b68f9b68483955b85042dac7b4533757779625a02dcf91e470da4c2df1b430be semgrep scan --config tools/semgrep/p-python.yaml apps/api/app --error --metrics=off

lanes.name: test-mutation
lanes.command: uv sync --frozen --package gaia --group backend --group dev && python3 scripts/ci/mutation.py local

lanes.name: seo
lanes.$comment: ts-build-test's seo check: the sitemap crawl and the squirrelscan ratchet (scripts/ci/baselines/squirrel-build.txt) against this checkout's production web build. scope mirrors changes.sh SEO_INPUTS (held equal by scripts/ci/tests/test_changes.py). Known delta: apps/web/mise.toml sets NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL to the local API inside the build, whose prerender then cannot reach it; run it with node and pnpm on PATH ahead of mise's shims and NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://api.heygaia.io/api/v1/.
